description.zh: DBGateway的ID，是DBGateway的唯一标识。可通过[DescribeCloudbenchTask](~~230669~~)接口获取，返回的**ClientGatewayId**字段值即为DBGateway的ID。
description.en:
The unique ID of the database gateway.

Note: You can get this ID from the `ClientGatewayId` field in the response of the [DescribeCloudbenchTask](~~230669~~)  API.

descriptions.zh:
- 本接口用于删除[CreateCloudBenchTasks](~~230665~~)接口创建的智能压测任务中已释放的DBgateway元数据。
- 在使用SDK调用DAS服务时，需要将地域指定为cn-shanghai。

> 当DBGateway与接入点超过20秒无心跳时，此DBGateway为停止状态。
descriptions.en:
Call this API to delete metadata for inactive database gateway instances that were created during stress testing created by the [CreateCloudBenchTasks](~~230665~~) operation.

When you use an SDK to call the DAS service, you must specify the region as `cn-shanghai`.

> A database gateway is considered "stopped" if it has not sent a heartbeat to the DAS service for more than 20 seconds.
